description: This file defines the configuration options class 'LeaseBasedQueueBalancerOptions' used to configure a lease-based queue balancer in Orleans streaming.</br>It includes properties for lease length, renewal period, acquisition period, and lease category, with default values and some obsolete members for backwards compatibility.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerOptions
classes.description: Configuration class for lease-based queue balancer settings, allowing users to specify lease duration, renewal, acquisition periods, and category.
